paragraphs.text: The Forsaken Monument is a legendary artifact and landmark on Zendikar .

The Forsaken Monument is the remnant of an Eldrazi Monument that remain on Zendikar following the Eldrazi 's destruction on the plane. It is a giant stone statue in the shape of a Ulamog spawn's upper body and head coming out of the ground.
Supposedly, it originally was created by the Eternal Pilgrims .
